rules: Do not replace, redraw, crop, recolor, or rescale the canonical mascot artwork internally.
Do not use clovi-idle.png, clovi-wave.png, frame assets, or limb layers in the login hero.
Only the extracted original eye pixels may move; the canonical image, background, props, and body stay fixed.
At zero eye offset the base and eye layer must reconstruct the canonical artwork pixel-for-pixel.
Responsive changes may only alter the outer stage size and position within the approved display envelope.
